summary: Workflow: profile, analyse, visualise and write up a dataset as a report.
intents: turn this CSV into a finished report with charts and conclusions
analyse this dataset end to end and write up the findings
profile, analyse and chart this data, then summarize it for stakeholders
build a data report from this spreadsheet export
give me an insights write-up from this data file
prerequisites: a dataset file (CSV, JSON or spreadsheet export)
the question the report should answer

steps.goal: Profile columns, types, missing values and duplicates before analysis
Answer the question with queries and summary statistics
Chart the two or three findings that matter most
Write the report: question, method, findings, caveats and next steps

done_when: Data quality issues are reported before conclusions
Every number in the report traces to a query or statistic
